text:
marco: Hey team — planning to spend Apr–Jun in Malta, then back in SF. Want to confirm how to declare temporary homebase, impact on WFH stipend, and whether this creates a tax nexus for Redwood. Any quick guidance? :wave:
people-ops: Hi @marco — thanks for the heads up! Short answers: 1) please submit the Homebase Change form (https://redwood.company/forms/homebase) so we can start payroll checks, 2) stipend is prorated for partial months, 3) tax nexus depends on activities/length — see below for details. Can you share intended dates and whether you'll keep SF address for benefits?
sara-people-ops: also add whether you want relocation assistance vs just temporary shipping (we have a $1,200 cap for short moves). If laptop courier needed ping `#it-ship` and include asset tag.
marco: dates are 2026-04-01 through 2026-06-30, back in SF on 2026-07-01. Will keep SF apartment, but will register as temporary resident in Malta for the three months. No household move, just personal items.
ben_finance: Quick math on stipend proration: monthly WFH stipend = $200. For Apr (full month) you'll get $200. Jun is full month too. If any partial months we prorate by days: ``PRORATED = monthly_amount * (days_in_country / days_in_month)``. Expense cap for shipping = $1,200, need receipts. We'll also need to check payroll currency for that period (you'll remain on USD payroll unless we route via our EOR).
tax-eng: Heads-up — 90 days in many EU countries is a common threshold but Malta has its own regs. Key points: if you perform work for Redwood while physically present, local tax/social security rules may apply; 183-day is not the only test. We should run a short nexus check with our tax partner. Please share whether you'll meet with customers or be doing product demos from Malta.
people-ops: @tax-eng noted — @marco, please answer customer-facing / contract work question. We'll queue a nexus review once the form is in. Meanwhile we'll estimate stipend proration and shipping.
marco: No customer meetings planned, mostly heads-down dev and async collaboration.
people-ops-bot: FYI — Updated policy memo: "Temporary Remote: <=6 months" published: https://redwood.company/policies/temporary-remote. It includes checklist (homebase form, passport, local contact, receipt uploads).
sara-people-ops: Action items for @marco: 1) submit Homebase Change form, 2) upload passport/flight, 3) confirm whether you want relocation shipping or just courier for work devices, 4) authorize payroll check for USD. I'll kick off the stipend proration and shipping approval once items are in.
marco: Thanks — submitted the form and uploaded flight. Choosing courier for laptop only. Appreciate the quick responses! :pray
